label: EU Real GDP Growth
value: +0.4% q/q Q2 2026 (Eurostat); Q1 revised to flat 0.0%
change: Eurozone Q2 2026 GDP grew +0.4% q/q — ahead of the +0.2% consensus — rebounding from a flat Q1 (revised up from the earlier -0.2% contraction estimate); annual growth reached +1.0% (euro area) / +1.2% (EU); Germany, France and Italy each posted +0.2% q/q, Spain +0.7%, Ireland led at +3.9%

label: Eurozone HICP Inflation
change: +0.4pp vs July's 2.9%, the highest reading since September 2023; energy +14.3% y/y (vs +10.3% in July) as Strait of Hormuz shipping disruption and the Iran war pushed oil prices higher; services eased to 3.0% (from 3.3%), core inflation slipped to 2.4%; Spain highest among majors at 4.5%
source: Eurostat — HICP flash estimate, August 2026 (released Sep 1)

label: ECB Deposit Facility Rate
change: Governing Council raised all three key rates +25bp on September 10 (deposit facility to 2.50%, main refinancing to 2.65%, marginal lending to 2.90%, effective September 16) — the second hike of 2026 after June's increase and July's pause — citing Middle East conflict-driven energy inflation; new staff projections see headline HICP averaging 3.0% in 2026, 2.5% in 2027, 2.1% in 2028
